verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform for hosting AI agents, so letting those agents connect to MCP servers is a fair question and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or registering external tool servers. Chat channels, Google account connection and custom Docker frameworks are adjacent features, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
